algorithm: Liepa 2003 stage 2 (triangulation) as minimum-area dynamic programming over the boundary loop (O(n^3)); refinement and fairing not applied here

planar.input: 10 x 10 cell grid on [0,10]^2 with the 2 x 2 centre cells removed (192 triangles, one 8-edge inner loop)

sphere.input: icosphere R 10 level 3 with the faces near the +Z pole removed (all vertices within 2.5 mm of the axis, z > 0)
sphere.note: without refinement + fairing the patch is flat; with Liepa refinement + fairing the volume must move back toward the original (VC-MSH-05 sphere tolerance TBD — measure with fill_mesh_holes fairing "curvature")
